items.title: OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification Out For 89 Posts, Apply Online
items.doc_text: Exams » OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 The OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 notification is out for 89 Group-B vacancies in Odisha’s State Forensic Science Service Organisation under the Home Department. The recruitment covers 10 divisions, including Physics, Chemistry, Biology, DNA and Cyber Forensic. Eligible candidates can apply online from 6 to 26 November 2026 at www.opsc.gov.in. Check eligibility, vacancies, fees and selection details before applying. OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026: Overview Candidates can check the key details of the OPSC Scientific Officer Vacancy 2026 in the table below. Particulars Details Recruiting Authority Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) Department Home Department, Government of Odisha Organisation State Forensic Science Service Organisation Post Name Scientific Officer (Group-B) Advertisement Number 14 of 2026-27 Total Vacancies 89 Number of Divisions 10 Application Mode Online Notification Date 28 October 2026 Application Start Date 6 November 2026 Last Date to Apply 26 November 2026, 5:00 PM Written Examination Date 17 January 2027 Selection Process Written Examination and Personality Test/Viva Voce Official Website www.opsc.gov.in OPSC Scientific Officer Notification 2026 PDF The OPSC Scientific Officer Notification 2026 contains details about 89 vacancies, division-wise posts, eligibility criteria, age limit, reservation, application dates, fees, selection process and examination pattern. Candidates should review the complete advertisement before applying. The official notification PDF link is provided below. OPSC Scientific Officer Notification 2026 PDF OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026: Important Dates The Odisha Public Service Commission has announced the key dates for the Scientific Officer recruitment process. Candidates can check the notification date, online application schedule and written examination date in the table below. Event Date Notification Release Date 28 October 2026 Online Application Starts 6 November 2026 Last Date to Apply Online 26 November 2026, 5:00 PM Written Examination Date 17 January 2027 Exam Centre and Detailed Schedule To be announced OPSC Scientific Officer Vacancy 2026 The Odisha Public Service Commission has announced 89 vacancies across 10 forensic science divisions. Candidates can check the division-wise vacancy distribution below. Scientific Officer Division Vacancies Physics 7 Ballistics 6 Chemistry 10 Toxicology 13 Biology 14 Serology 4 DNA 12 Forensic Psychology 6 Cyber Forensic 11 Document 6 Total 89 OPSC Scientific Officer Apply Online 2026 The online application process for OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 will begin on 6 November 2026. Eligible candidates can register, fill out the application form, upload the required documents and pay the applicable fee through the official OPSC website. The last date to submit the application and complete the fee payment is 26 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. The direct application link will be activated here once the online application process begins. OPSC Scientific Officer Apply Online 2026 (Link Active Soon) OPSC Scientific Officer Application Fee 2026 Candidates must pay the prescribed examination fee while submitting the online application, unless they qualify for an exemption. Category Application Fee General and other non-exempt candidates ₹700 SC/ST/PwD Exempted How to Apply for OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 Candidates can follow the steps below to complete the online application as prescribed in the notification: Visit the official website, www.opsc.gov.in. Read Advertisement No. 14 of 2026-27 carefully. Register on the portal and obtain the PPSAN, as required. Log in and fill out the online application form. Select only one forensic science division. Upload your photograph, full signature and Left-Hand Thumb Impression (LTI). Upload the required certificates and documents in the prescribed format, including a single PDF of up to 10 MB where specified. Pay the applicable examination fee online. Eligible SC, ST and PwD candidates are exempted as per the notification. Verify the details and submit the application before the deadline. Print and keep a copy of the submitted application form for future reference. OPSC Scientific Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026 Candidates applying for the Scientific Officer posts must fulfil the educational qualification, age limit and other conditions prescribed by OPSC. Eligibility is assessed according to the selected division and the requirements mentioned in the official advertisement. Educational Qualification Applicants must possess a postgraduate or Master’s degree, or an accepted equivalent qualification, in the relevant discipline from a recognised university. Candidates must have secured a minimum of 55% aggregate marks, subject to the conditions specified in the notification. The required subject specialisation differs across the 10 divisions. For example, Cyber Forensic requires a relevant qualification in a prescribed computer-related, cyber security, digital forensic or forensic science specialisation. Forensic Psychology and Document divisions have specific subject requirements that candidates must verify in the detailed advertisement. Candidates must also fulfil the prescribed Odia language requirement, including the required Odia qualification and proficiency conditions. Age Limit The prescribed age limit for OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 is given below. Particulars Age Minimum Age 21 years Maximum Age 42 years Age Calculation Date 1 January 2026 Candidates must have attained 21 years of age and must not have exceeded 42 years as on 1 January 2026. Age Relaxation Age relaxation is applicable to eligible categories according to the recruitment rules. Category Age Relaxation SEBC 5 years SC 5 years ST 5 years Women 5 years, as applicable under the rules Ex-Servicemen As prescribed under the applicable rules PwD Candidates 10 years, subject to the notification OPSC Scientific Officer Selection Process 2026 The selection process consists of a written examination followed by a Personality Test/Viva Voce. Candidates must qualify at the prescribed stages and fulfil all eligibility and document-verification requirements. The selection stages are: Written Examination: Candidates will appear for Paper I and Paper II. Personality Test/Viva Voce: Candidates qualifying for this stage will be assessed according to the commission’s prescribed procedure. OPSC Scientific Officer Exam Pattern 2026 The written examination comprises two papers covering general aptitude and the subject knowledge relevant to the selected division. Paper Subjects Marks Duration Paper I General English, General Awareness, General Aptitude and Reasoning 100 90 minutes Paper II Subject-specific questions for the selected division 300 150 minutes Total Written Examination Both papers 400 4 hours Both papers consist of objective-type multiple-choice questions. A negative marking provision applies: 25% of the marks allotted to a question are deducted for an incorrect answer, as specified in the examination scheme. The Personality Test/Viva Voce carries an additional 50 marks, taking the total selection-stage marks to 450. OPSC Scientific Officer Salary 2026 Selected candidates will receive a salary under Level 10, Cell-1 of the Pay Matrix, with an initial basic pay of ₹44,900 per month. Other admissible allowances and service benefits will be governed by the applicable Odisha Government rules. OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 FAQs Ques. How many vacancies are announced under OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026? A total of 89 Scientific Officer vacancies have been announced across 10 forensic science divisions. When will the OPSC Scientific Officer application process begin? Online applications will begin on 6 November 2026. What is the last date to apply for OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026? The last date to submit the application form and complete fee payment is 26 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Ques. What is the educational qualification for Scientific Officer posts? Candidates generally need a relevant postgraduate or Master’s degree with at least 55% aggregate marks. The precise qualification depends on the selected forensic science division. Ques. What is the age limit for OPSC Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026? Candidates must be between 21 and 42 years of age as on 1 January 2026, subject to applicable age relaxations. Ques. What is the salary of an OPSC Scientific Officer? The initial basic pay is ₹44,900 under Level 10, Cell-1 of the Pay Matrix, along with admissible allowances. Ques. Can a candidate apply for more than one division? No. Candidates can apply for only one division under Advertisement No. 14 of 2026-27. Ques. When will the OPSC Scientific Officer written examination be conducted? The written examination is scheduled for 17 January 2027.
